period_note: Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 30 September 2022' (the filing also separately shows a discrete '01 July to 30 September' 3-month column, not used here). Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (3rd_quarter_2022.pdf) is a native digital PDF with a clean pdftotext -layout extraction; figures cross-verified: balance sheet ties to the taka (Total Liabilities 265,669,983,554 + Total Shareholders' Equity 23,148,052,346 = Total Assets 288,818,035,900); Profit after provision 4,331,116,354 - Contribution to NCC Bank's CSR Fund 43,311,164 = Profit before tax 4,287,805,190 - Provision for tax 1,780,515,974 = Profit after tax (full) 2,507,289,216; less 'Interest on perpetual bonds' (BDT 340.4mn) = 'Net profit attributable to ordinary shareholders' BDT 2,166,869,008, the basis for the reported EPS of 2.05. profit_after_tax_cumulative below is the FULL PAT, per project convention. RECLASSIFICATION NOTED (not an economic restatement): this filing's comparative 'Jan-Sep 2021' column shows Interest paid on deposits and borrowings of BDT 5,865.30mn and a new 'Interest on perpetual bonds' line of BDT 36.11mn, versus the 2021_Q3.json record's BDT 5,901.42mn interest expense with no separate perpetual-bond line -- the two numbers differ by exactly the BDT 36.11mn now shown separately, and the resulting 'Net profit attributable to ordinary shareholders' comparative (BDT 2,015,478,525) matches the 2021_Q3.json Profit after tax figure exactly; this is a presentation reclassification (moving the perpetual bond coupon from pre-tax interest expense to a post-tax appropriation) with no change to the bottom-line distributable profit, not a genuine restatement. Cross-check: comparative '31 December 2021' Total Shareholders' Equity (BDT 22,196.36mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2021_Q4.json exactly; comparative Total Assets (BDT 277,894.17mn) remains about 1.0% above that file's BDT 275,037mn, the same gap noted in the 2022_Q1/Q2 files.
